subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow facts should OpenClaw show in user-visible channel replies versus keep only in logs or metadata?
rationale: The implementation can access model, token, overage, and session facts, but deciding whether and how to expose raw or redacted session/channel identifiers and exact token counts is a product/privacy decision.

options.title: Show Redacted Diagnostics
options.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget, estimated or observed token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

options.title: Keep Details Operator-Only
options.body: Keep chat copy generic and document how operators can inspect logs or status metadata for detailed context-pressure facts.

options.title: Defer To Broader Context Visibility
options.body: Keep this issue open until a broader context-visibility design decides chat, logs, status, and notification behavior together.

recommendation.title: Show Redacted Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget, estimated or observed token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent ownership signal across the runner and auto-reply paths where the visible behavior must be decided.
